description:
EnduranceRoad - Comfortable Domination: This Century PRO DISC Carbon Disc brake endurance road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

2026 FEATURES: Advanced Carbon Frame Design with DynamicAngle Chainstay. Dynamic AngleStay, Allows shorter chainstay for more precise handling and reduces eliminates chain strikes.

Comes with fast/efficient Vitttoria tires, but capable of using up to 700x50c* to dominate gravel roads. Vittorias are known for maximum speed with comfort and efficiency. Laugh and float over rough roads, gravel, chipseal and revel in your powerful disc brakes through virtually all weather conditions.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the pro level performance of a Carbon frame, coupled with the Shimano R7000 22 Speed shifting precision and pro handling of a Carbon fork.
